description: Elia: Imbalance price per minute (Historical data as of 22/05/2024), published by Elia Transmission Belgium, archives one-minute imbalance indicators. Coverage: The product concerns the Belgian transmission system, its generating units or bidding-zone borders as specified by its fields. Provider granularity: 1 minute. Declared refresh interval: Daily. These are metadata statements, not an independently checked completeness period. The linked provider API exposes the product metadata and field definitions. The review did not retrieve observation rows or bulk exports. Elia labels the product with its Elia Open Data Licence. The metadata is publicly accessible without a login; licence conditions still govern reuse. Limitations: These one-minute indicators are never validated and are indicative; they must not be substituted for quarter-hour settlement values. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
